verses.restored: O sing to YHWH a new song: sing to YHWH, all the earth.

familiar.text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

modern.text: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

original.text: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Sing to YHWH, bless his name; show forth his salvation from day to day.

familiar.text: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

modern.text: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.

original.text: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Declare his glory among the nations, his wonders among all people.

familiar.text: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

modern.text: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.

original.text: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: For YHWH is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

familiar.text: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

modern.text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.

original.text: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but YHWH made the heavens.

familiar.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

modern.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.

original.text: כִּ֤י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

familiar.text: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

modern.text: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.

original.text: הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ

verses.restored: Give to YHWH, O ye kindreds of the people, give to YHWH glory and strength.

familiar.text: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

modern.text: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

original.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז

verses.restored: Give to YHWH the glory due to his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

familiar.text: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

modern.text: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.

original.text: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: O worship YHWH in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

familiar.text: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

modern.text: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

original.text: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: Say among the nations, “YHWH reigns.” The world is firmly established; it will not be moved. He judges the peoples with equity.

familiar.text: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

modern.text: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

original.text: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים

verses.restored: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

familiar.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

modern.text: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.

original.text: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ

modern.text: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy

modern.text: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
